entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I need a refund.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
Alex Diaz, order number 774-B-91. Look, I don't have time for a long call, I just need to know how to send this thing back.
Okay, Alex, I have your order pulled up. I see the VeloBand was delivered 21 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is completely wrong. Honestly, the product is garbage.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. We do have a dedicated technical support team that can walk you through a calibration or troubleshoot the issue. I can transfer you—
No. I don't have time to sit on the phone with another department. I don't want to fix it. I just want my money back for the defective product you sent me.
I understand your frustration, Alex. Just one moment while I review the return eligibility for your order.
It should be eligible. It doesn't work.
Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like you received the item 21 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Okay, good. So what's the next step?

I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now. I've just sent it to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
